name: @xaiop/sdk-timing
description: SDK stage timing facade — Node / Python / Java / Go under timing/{node,python,java,go}

scripts.bench:java: mvn -f ../java/pom.xml -q -DskipTests install && mvn -f java/pom.xml -q compile exec:java
scripts.bench:java:quick: mvn -f ../java/pom.xml -q -DskipTests install && mvn -f java/pom.xml -q compile exec:java "-Dexec.args=--quick"
scripts.bench:java:save-baseline: mvn -f ../java/pom.xml -q -DskipTests install && mvn -f java/pom.xml -q compile exec:java "-Dexec.args=--save-baseline"
scripts.bench:java:json: mvn -f ../java/pom.xml -q -DskipTests install && mvn -f java/pom.xml -q compile exec:java "-Dexec.args=--json"
scripts.bench:java:json-gate: mvn -f ../java/pom.xml -q -DskipTests install && mvn -f java/pom.xml -q compile exec:java@json-gate
scripts.bench:java:json-gate:quick: mvn -f ../java/pom.xml -q -DskipTests install && mvn -f java/pom.xml -q compile exec:java@json-gate "-Dexec.args=--quick"
